name: Pool of Tears
summary: In Stonard, Fel'zerul asks you to search around the Pool of Tears for Atal'ai artifacts. The Warchief sent Fel'zerul's people to look into strange events at the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, and they arrived to find it sunk.

sections.title: The Sunken Temple
sections.body: The Atal'ai trolls are dark casters, a tribe notorious for forbidden magic. When Fel'zerul's party reached the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, they were astonished to find it sunk. Green dragons now watch over the place and call themselves protectors of Azeroth.

sections.title: Pieces of a Puzzle
sections.body: Fel'zerul wants to learn what happened, and asks you to range around the Pool of Tears gathering Atal'ai artifacts, from which the puzzle can begin to fit together. Nobody knows what dark rites were practised in the temple, only that great magical forces were used. Fel'zerul hopes the Atal'ai's spells may prove useful to the Horde, and wants to understand what the trolls hoped to achieve and what went so horribly wrong.

faq.answer: Fel'zerul is in Stonard, one of those the Warchief sent to investigate odd goings-on at the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in the Atal'ai trolls?
faq.answer: Fel'zerul points out that great magical forces were used there, and thinks the Atal'ai's spells may prove useful to the Horde.

faq.q: Where are the Atal'ai artifacts located?
faq.answer: They lie on the bed of the Pool of Tears, near the temple.

faq.q: Who guards the sunken temple now?
faq.answer: Green dragons watch over the place and call themselves protectors of Azeroth.

faq.q: What comes next after the artifacts are delivered?
aliases: next quest after pool of tears
